provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: The mechanism (find 4-connected pockets of background, paint the largest with colour 8 and the smallest with colour 7) is invariant under all D4 transforms because 4-connectivity and region sizes are preserved by rotations/reflections; no direction or axis needs to be rewritten. Palette is handled by specializing colour roles: background = palette[0], largest-fill = palette[8], smallest-fill = palette[7]. The emitted program works directly on visible coordinates with BFS flood fill over background-coloured cells.
draft_notes.limitations: Relies on the generator's guarantee of a unique largest and unique smallest pocket; if ties occurred, the choice would follow stable sort order of reading-order discovery. If only one pocket exists, it would be painted 8 then overwritten with 7 (same as the archived solver); the generator does not produce such scenes.
